items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: me and Paul and Bill Hardman-- ... And me, Bill Hardman and Paul, man, cat on in town, man. And he taught--he taught--he taught me a lot, man, about this business

ctx.x: And so Peck was--was playing his last gig so--well, the place was jam-packed with people, man. So I'm--you know, I've heard Bradshaw's band, you know. So I looked up there and I--in the band. I saw some guys up there my age--which was Bill Hardman what was in the band.
